name: Bloodsoaked Ruins
assumptions: Passive "Mournful Tribute" is not modelled yet: the weapon contributes only its base ATK and secondary stat. R1 text: For 3.5s after using an Elemental Burst, the equipping character's Lunar-Charged DMG dealt to opponents is increased by 36%. Additionally, after triggering a Lunar-Charged reaction, the equipping character will gain Requiem of Ruin: CRIT DMG is increased by 28% for 6s. They will also regain 12 Elemental Energy. Elemental Energy can be restored this way once every 14s.
Obtain method is a guess from rarity and has not been verified in a source page.
Base ATK and secondary stat are from genshin-db only (not cross-checked in a second source).
